summary.text: Says Merkley wants to end political corruption by stopping stock trading and reforming the Supreme Court.
summary.quote: No more stock trading; no more exchanging government favors for investments in Trump’s companies. The Supreme Court needs reform and a binding code of ethics.

summary.text: Says Merkley wants to transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
summary.quote: Rapidly transition from dirty, expensive fossils to cheaper, cleaner, renewables.

summary.text: Says Merkley wants to expand vote-by-mail and stop gerrymandering.
summary.quote: Stop gerrymandering. Require paper ballots. End secret campaign funding. Expand vote-by-mail.
